questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the system of managing money in a country'?
explanation: Economy is correct - E-C-O-N-O-M-Y. The economy refers to the financial system of a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'money paid by citizens to the government'?
explanation: Taxation is correct - T-A-X-A-T-I-O-N. Taxation is the system of collecting money from citizens for public use.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a country ruled by elected representatives'?
explanation: Republic is correct - R-E-P-U-B-L-I-C. A republic is governed by elected representatives of the people.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a plan for spending money'?
explanation: Budget is correct - B-U-D-G-E-T. A budget is a financial plan that estimates income and expenses.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'money borrowed from a bank'?
explanation: Loan is correct - L-O-A-N. A loan is a sum of money borrowed that is expected to be paid back with interest.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the rise in general prices'?
explanation: Inflation is correct - I-N-F-L-A-T-I-O-N. Inflation is the rate at which the general price level rises over time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an elected assembly that makes laws'?
explanation: Parliament is correct - P-A-R-L-I-A-M-E-N-T. Parliament is the highest legislative body in many countries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a government grant to help an industry'?
explanation: Subsidy is correct - S-U-B-S-I-D-Y. A subsidy is financial aid given by the government to support an industry.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a duty on imported goods'?
explanation: Tariff is correct - T-A-R-I-F-F. A tariff is a tax on imported or exported goods. Double F.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the buying and selling of goods between countries'?
explanation: Commerce is correct - C-O-M-M-E-R-C-E. Commerce is the activity of buying and selling goods. Double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'income from investments or work'?
explanation: Revenue is correct - R-E-V-E-N-U-E. Revenue is the income generated by a business or government.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ownership of property by the state'?
explanation: Nationalisation is correct - N-A-T-I-O-N-A-L-I-S-A-T-I-O-N. Nationalisation is when the state takes control of private industry.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a fall in economic activity'?
explanation: Recession is correct - R-E-C-E-S-S-I-O-N. A recession is a period of reduced economic activity. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a written agreement between two countries'?
explanation: Bilateral is correct - B-I-L-A-T-E-R-A-L. A bilateral agreement involves two parties or countries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the value of a currency'?
explanation: Denomination is correct - D-E-N-O-M-I-N-A-T-I-O-N. A denomination is a unit of currency.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the practice of managing public finances'?
explanation: Fiscal is correct - F-I-S-C-A-L. Fiscal relates to government revenue and expenditure.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'selling state assets to private owners'?
explanation: Privatisation is correct - P-R-I-V-A-T-I-S-A-T-I-O-N. Privatisation transfers state-owned assets to the private sector.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal process for choosing leaders'?
explanation: Election is correct - E-L-E-C-T-I-O-N. An election is the process of choosing representatives by voting.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a document allowing someone to vote'?
explanation: Ballot is correct - B-A-L-L-O-T. A ballot is a method of voting, often using a paper or card. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an international trade restriction'?
explanation: Embargo is correct - E-M-B-A-R-G-O. An embargo is an official ban on trade with a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'money paid to a government as a fine'?
explanation: Penalty is correct - P-E-N-A-L-T-Y. A penalty is a punishment imposed for breaking a law or rule.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the right to vote in an election'?
explanation: Franchise is correct - F-R-A-N-C-H-I-S-E. Franchise means the right to vote in public elections.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a union of states with a central government'?
explanation: Confederation is correct - C-O-N-F-E-D-E-R-A-T-I-O-N. A confederation is a union of states with limited central power.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a person who buys goods or services'?
explanation: Consumer is correct - C-O-N-S-U-M-E-R. A consumer is an individual who purchases goods or services.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the practice of living within budget'?
explanation: Austerity is correct - A-U-S-T-E-R-I-T-Y. Austerity refers to strict policies to reduce government spending.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the distribution of wealth and opportunities'?
explanation: Equity is correct - E-Q-U-I-T-Y. Equity means fairness and justice in the distribution of resources.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a long period of economic decline'?
explanation: Depression is correct - D-E-P-R-E-S-S-I-O-N. An economic depression is a severe, prolonged downturn. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the overall economy of a region'?
explanation: Macroeconomics is correct - M-A-C-R-O-E-C-O-N-O-M-I-C-S. Macroeconomics studies large-scale economic factors.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a legal order to pay money'?
explanation: Indemnity is correct - I-N-D-E-M-N-I-T-Y. Indemnity is protection or insurance against financial loss.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the policy of not interfering in trade'?
explanation: Laissez-faire is correct - L-A-I-S-S-E-Z-F-A-I-R-E. Laissez-faire means minimal government interference in business. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the transfer of power to regional governments'?
explanation: Devolution is correct - D-E-V-O-L-U-T-I-O-N. Devolution transfers government powers from central to local authorities.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a tax on goods produced in a country'?
explanation: Excise is correct - E-X-C-I-S-E. Excise duty is a tax levied on goods produced or sold within a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'income earned from property or capital'?
explanation: Dividend is correct - D-I-V-I-D-E-N-D. A dividend is a share of profits paid to shareholders.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a tax to reduce foreign imports'?
explanation: Protectionism is correct - P-R-O-T-E-C-T-I-O-N-I-S-M. Protectionism uses tariffs to shield domestic industries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a political system based on communal ownership'?
explanation: Communism is correct - C-O-M-M-U-N-I-S-M. Communism advocates collective ownership of the means of production. Double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the process of opening up markets to trade'?
explanation: Liberalisation is correct - L-I-B-E-R-A-L-I-S-A-T-I-O-N. Liberalisation reduces government restrictions on trade.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the flow of goods and services in an economy'?
explanation: Circulation is correct - C-I-R-C-U-L-A-T-I-O-N. Circulation refers to the movement of money and goods in an economy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'money set aside for a specific purpose'?
explanation: Allocation is correct - A-L-L-O-C-A-T-I-O-N. Allocation is the distribution of resources for a specific purpose. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the total value of goods produced in a country'?
explanation: Gross domestic product is correct - G-R-O-S-S D-O-M-E-S-T-I-C P-R-O-D-U-C-T. GDP measures a country total economic output.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a system based on private ownership'?
explanation: Capitalism is correct - C-A-P-I-T-A-L-I-S-M. Capitalism is an economic system based on private ownership and free markets.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a form of government with religious authority'?
explanation: Theocracy is correct - T-H-E-O-C-R-A-C-Y. A theocracy is a government based on divine or religious authority.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the income of a government from all sources'?
explanation: Treasury is correct - T-R-E-A-S-U-R-Y. The treasury is the government department managing public funds.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of the economy at household level'?
explanation: Microeconomics is correct - M-I-C-R-O-E-C-O-N-O-M-I-C-S. Microeconomics studies individual and household economic decisions.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a person who represents a country abroad'?
explanation: Diplomat is correct - D-I-P-L-O-M-A-T. A diplomat is an official who represents their country in another country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a law passed by the government'?
explanation: Legislation is correct - L-E-G-I-S-L-A-T-I-O-N. Legislation refers to laws made by a governing body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an agreement between parties'?
explanation: Treaty is correct - T-R-E-A-T-Y. A treaty is a formal and binding agreement between countries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a sum of money set aside for public use'?
explanation: Appropriation is correct - A-P-P-R-O-P-R-I-A-T-I-O-N. Appropriation is the act of setting aside money for a specific purpose. Double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the difference between imports and exports'?
explanation: Trade deficit is correct - T-R-A-D-E D-E-F-I-C-I-T. A trade deficit occurs when a country imports more than it exports.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a global spread of a disease'?
explanation: Pandemic is correct - P-A-N-D-E-M-I-C. A pandemic is a disease outbreak that spreads across many countries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a group of nations with shared goals'?
explanation: Coalition is correct - C-O-A-L-I-T-I-O-N. A coalition is a temporary alliance of groups for combined action.
